correctness.rationale: The source equation preceding Theorem 5.1 explicitly gives \(\beta_1=-0.6956435964\lambda_1+43.44299811\lambda_2\) and positive scaling \(\bar\beta_1=(b^4/a^3)\beta_1\) with \(a=4.537776612\times10^{-4}>0\), \(b=0.4552873824>0\). Thus the first coefficient must be negative. Fresh high-precision decimal replay gives approximately \(-319889446.9717\), consistent with \(-3.19889447\times10^8\), and the second coefficient approximately \(1.99771214917\times10^{10}\). The source immediately before its Theorem 5.1 indeed prints that negative coefficient; its equation (16) alone switches to positive. The source's own saddle-node tangent is \(-\bar\lambda_1+62.4500798\bar\lambda_2=0\), whereas the printed positive sign would yield the opposite first-parameter tangent. Primary PDF page 3224 was visually inspected and directly establishes both discrepancies. Rounded source data certify sign and displayed precision, not hidden full-model center manifold.
correctness.risk: Corrects one printed normal-form term only, without recalculating model equilibria, BT2 location or complete global bifurcation curves.
